entry.command: python3 -B -c 'import pathlib,json; P=pathlib.Path; out={"links":[],"init_scripts":{},"fstab_nfs_entries":[]}; roots=[P("/etc/systemd/system"),P("/lib/systemd/system"),P("/run/systemd/generator"),P("/run/systemd/generator.early"),P("/run/systemd/generator.late")]; [(out["links"].append({"path":str(p),"target":str(p.resolve())})) for r in roots if r.exists() for p in r.rglob("*") if p.is_symlink() and any(s in p.name for s in ["nfs","mountd"])]; [(out["init_scripts"].update({str(p):p.read_text()})) for p in P("/etc/init.d").glob("*nfs*") if p.is_file()]; out["fstab_nfs_entries"]=[l for l in P("/etc/fstab").read_text().splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith("#") and "nfs" in l]; print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))'
